## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows `type(scope): subject`, for example `feat(courier): add retry`
- [ ] Changed action keeps its inputs and outputs backward compatible (or the PR says it is breaking)
- [ ] `scripts/*.sh` pass shellcheck and the tests in `tests/` pass
- [ ] `README.md` table updated for a new action
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private keys in the diff
- [ ] Docs (`README.md`) updated when behaviour or setup changed
